meta.name: The Great Indian Dysfunctional Family 720p
meta.description: After an accident during border duty, General Vikramjeet Ranaut settles down for a quiet and happy life with his family in his ancestral home. When his estranged brother and sister-in-law return after 8 years, things spiral out of control.

videos.title: Meet the Ranauts
videos.overview: A brother's return after eight years reopens old wounds. Is he still welcome at his childhood home?

videos.title: The Wedding Fiasco
videos.overview: The celebrations at Nandini’s sangeet are cut short with Aditi’s demand. The guests accidentally overhear the conversation between the two girls.

videos.title: The Aftermath
videos.overview: The morning after the debacle, Aditi and Vikram have a surprise for each other. The rest of the family can’t help but remain a mute spectator.

videos.title: A Deadly Secret
videos.overview: Everyone is caught off guard when Vikram's old friend shows up and demands payback.

videos.title: Wounds of the Past
videos.overview: The family’s past explains its present. Geeta tells Sonali that one incident which changed Vikram forever.

videos.title: It Happened One Night
videos.overview: The secret is out! Vikram learns Geeta’s secret and Sonali realizes that Samar lied to her about what happened eight years ago.

videos.title: Testing Times
videos.overview: The past and its mistake slowly catch up with the Ranauts. Everything goes in disarray as Mridul goes missing.

videos.title: The Beginning of the End
videos.overview: Vikram drags Samar to the hospital to take the paternity test. Sonali decides to leave for Mumbai.

videos.title: A Life Less Ordinary
videos.overview: Premlata battles for her life in the hospital. She accidentally lets it slip about the time when Vikram secretly saved Samar.

videos.title: A Glimmer of Hope
videos.overview: The Ranauts hear Premlata’s will and her last wish. The result of the paternity test is out, and everyone braces for the ultimate answer.
